status: Hand-authored expected review decisions only; no runtime loads this file and no test runner is added.

cases.proposed: Owned complete byte/UTF8 continuation; finite repertoire predicate; no Unicode algorithm dependency
cases.reason: Avoids any false Unicode18 algorithm/table claim; N1 implementation and owner acceptance remain pending.

cases.proposed: Use unicode-segmentation 1.13.3 to claim Unicode18 grapheme conformance
cases.reason: Pinned tables declare 17.0.0; no table/algorithm match to 18 is established.

cases.proposed: Use foundation unicode-width 0.2.2 as the inner Unicode18 width oracle
cases.reason: Pinned tables declare 17.0.0 and generic library output does not own terminal tailoring.

cases.proposed: Infer Unicode18 terminal support from build-time unicode-ident 1.0.27
cases.reason: Its 18.0.0 identifier tables implement a different property/algorithm purpose.

cases.proposed: Serialize private vte 0.15.0 Parser memory or reconstruct it from Perform callbacks
cases.reason: No public complete bounded continuation import/export; no private fork or opaque-state authority admitted.

cases.proposed: Parse {"grant":"a","grant":"b"} into Value and validate only its resulting map
cases.reason: Map insertion can erase a duplicate before authorization validation; a bounded visitor/prevalidation remains required.

cases.proposed: Accept an unknown authorization field because ordinary derived deserialization ignores it
cases.reason: The IPC contract requires explicit unknown-authority-field rejection; derive alone is insufficient.

cases.proposed: Read an unbounded request into a generic JSON value before checking frame size/depth
cases.reason: The selected codec does not enforce product resource limits before allocation.

cases.proposed: Silently refresh a source/hash after the URL returns different bytes
cases.reason: Preserve the original observation and review a separately dated exact replacement.

cases.proposed: Rewrite the old HTTP403 record because a new urllib request succeeds
cases.reason: Append the dated200 observation and bounded sections read; preserve the historical access failure.
